# PM004: story-restates-want

A story's `so_that` restates its `i_want`.

When most words of the value statement are already in the capability, the
story states the mechanism twice and no value.

## Remedy

Rewrite `so_that` to say what the capability buys the persona.

## Examples

### PM004 so_that restates i_want / A so_that that adds value is clean #1 (line 8) (clean)

```text
story a want=refuse_a_stale_base so=nothing_is_silently_reverted
```

### PM004 so_that restates i_want / A so_that that repeats i_want fires #2 (line 14) (fire)

```text
story a want=refuse_a_stale_base so=refuse_a_stale_base
```

### PM004 so_that restates i_want / A story without value parts is left to PM003 #3 (line 20) (clean)

